notes: The selection records the Desktop packages resolved with official DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
Public registry snapshots below are historical and must be refreshed before a new package upgrade decision.
The verifier checks current resolution, installed patch text, lockfile consistency, and mounts; validation.results records executed checks separately.
A selected version is not a packaged or user-data migration acceptance result.
